==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Used to be a trainee for [[SKT T1]].
* One of his parents is a dentist.
* Reached Rank 1 in Season 6 maining {{ci|Elise}} support.
* Mained and popularized Doran's Ring start and 3-4x Dark Seal on {{ci|Singed}} in Season 7.
* Popularized Unsealed Spellbook Ignite {{ci|Singed}} pre-Season 8.
* Reached Rank 1 in Season 8 maining {{ci|Singed}} top and {{ci|Shen}} support.
* First player in the LCK to play {{ci|Singed}} support.
** He played it on game 3 in a series against [[DWG KIA]] on January 17, 2022. 
* Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on August 10th, 2022.
** Was the 8th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK after [[GorillA]], [[Wolf (Lee Jae-wan) | Wolf]], [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[TusiN]], [[Deft]], and [[Peanut]].
* Reached 4000 assists in the LCK on August 10th, 2023.
** Was the 3rd player to reach 4000 assists in the LCK after [[GorillA]] and [[Faker]].
* Reached 5000 assists in the LCK on August 28th, 2024.
** Was the 2nd player to reach 5000 assists in the LCK after Faker.
* Reached 500 games in the LCK on July 22, 2023, becoming the 11th player to do so, after [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[Ruler]], [[Deft]], [[Bdd]], [[Teddy]], [[Peanut]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]], [[Kiin]], and [[Chovy]].
* Reached 600 games in the LCK on August 01, 2024, becoming the 8th player to do so, after Faker, Deft, Bdd, Peanut, Kiin, Teddy, and Chovy.
* Reached 700 games in the LCK on September 03, 2025, becoming the 8th player to do so, after Faker, Deft, Bdd, Peanut, Kiin, Chovy, and Teddy.
* Reached 300 wins in [[LCK]] on July 29, 2023, becoming the 11th player to do so after [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[GorillA]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Peanut]], [[Bdd]], [[Chovy]], and [[ShowMaker]].
** Hit this milestone in the same game as his KT teammate Kiin
* Reached 400 wins in [[LCK]] on April 05, 2025, becoming the 6th player to do so after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Peanut]], Bdd, and Chovy.
